title: Affiliate Ops Reconciler
one_liner: Upload Shopify/affiliate exports and get a reconciled creator payout ledger with tiered commissions, promo-code overlap handling, anomalies and payment-ready totals.
buyer: DTC Shopify brands with roughly 20-100 active creators that have outgrown spreadsheets but do not want enterprise affiliate software or a dedicated marketing-ops hire.

pain.description: Monthly reconciliation of creator commissions, custom tiers, promo-code overlaps and payouts becomes manual and error-prone as affiliate programs grow.

evidence.signal: A DTC skincare brand at about $300k/year with 35 creators says its Shopify plugin + large spreadsheet setup is becoming unmanageable and is actively evaluating affiliate-management software because reconciliation and payouts consume substantial team time.

A merchant reports a concrete creator-code/subscription-discount collision: creator commission should remain while customer discounts should not stack, illustrating reconciliation logic not handled cleanly by default tooling.

product_shape.v0: CSV/XLSX in -> normalized transactions -> deterministic commission rules -> overlap exceptions -> anomaly report -> creator payout ledger out.

distribution.primary: Shopify App Store if validation succeeds
distribution.secondary: Search intent around affiliate commission reconciliation, creator payout spreadsheets and discount-code overlap
distribution.constraint: Do not treat a Railway URL as distribution. No public launch until there is an actual acquisition route.

monetization_hypotheses: $29-$49 one-off reconciliation for a historical payout period
$39-$99/month for recurring reconciliation depending on creator/order volume
falsification: Obtain evidence from at least 5 independent merchants/threads/reviews that manual reconciliation, tier logic or payout exceptions are painful enough to seek a tool, and confirm existing products do not already solve the narrow workflow simply at low cost.
kill: Kill or radically reframe if the next evidence pass shows the pain is rare, already solved cleanly by low-cost incumbents, or requires deep attribution infrastructure before value can be delivered.
persist: Persist if multiple merchants independently describe spreadsheet-heavy reconciliation or discount/commission edge cases and there is a plausible marketplace/search acquisition channel.
scale: Only build a Shopify-native integration after a file-based reconciliation prototype proves people will use or pay for the output.
